title:
Triggered on `BUTTON_CLICK` of `Reliability.AdditionalSensorsSearchButton`.
The epic does the merges `assets` and `sensorDataReportsFilter` params for
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationHelper#fetchSensorsForSelectedAssets} data request triggered for `Reliability.AdditionalSensorsGrid`.

The `sensorDataReportsFilter` is created from currently selected and excluded sensors in `Reliability.AssetDataPrepSelectedSensorGrid` and `Reliability.AssetDataPrepExcludedSensorGrid`.
The `assets` are the selected assets in `Reliability.AdditionalSensorsForm`.
name: DataPreparationAdditionalSensorSearchEpic
